text: Kraft Heinz appoints Steve Cahillane as incoming CEO prior to its planned split, installs a merger-era chair, and transitions the current CEO to advisory status while separating leadership roles across future entities.

meta.note: Multiple leadership roles coexist across pre- and post-separation timelines, creating boundary ambiguity at the snapshot moment.

text: Delayed BLS reports show modest November payroll growth offset by a sharp October decline, rising unemployment, downward revisions to prior months, and sector-concentrated job gains amid data disruption.

meta.note: Household and establishment surveys diverge, and shutdown effects constrain clarity at the observation point.
